title: Prinsel
description: prinsel.com.mx Productos Infantiles Selectos S.A. de C.V. (PRINSEL) is a Mexican children's products company founded in 1960 in Toluca de Lerdo, State of Mexico, with 66 years of experience manufacturing and distributing children's footwear, clothing and accessories. With approximately 200 to 500 employees, it serves the Mexican market through retail stores and distribution networks. Its product range covers shoes, clothing, baby items and school supplies for children from newborns to age 16. The company also operates in real estate and building management through subsidiary structures. Its motto is Quality and Trust for Your Children, reflecting decades of brand recognition among Mexican families. Based in the State of Mexico, it remains one of the oldest and most established children's product companies in the country.
